50	/** Enumeration for memory region types. */

53	}

55	/** Describes a contiguous memory region.
56	  *
57	  * @param base       Base address (byte-granular, physical address).

63	/** Internal fabric source-side port (as seen by the DUT).
64	  *
65	  * A "source" drives addresses and write-data into the DUT and receives
66	  * read-data back from the DUT.  From the DUT perspective:
67	  *   - readDataAddr, writeDataAddr, writeDataBits, writeDataStrb are INPUTS
68	  *     (the source drives them).
69	  *   - readData is an OUTPUT (the DUT returns data to the source).
70	  */
71	class FabricSourcePort(dataBits: Int = 32, addrBits: Int = 32) extends Bundle {
72	  /** Read-request address.  valid = request pending; bits = byte address. */
73	  val readDataAddr  = Flipped(Valid(UInt(addrBits.W)))
74	  /** Write-request address. valid = request pending; bits = byte address. */
75	  val writeDataAddr = Flipped(Valid(UInt(addrBits.W)))
76	  /** Write data (aligned to bus). */
77	  val writeDataBits = Input(UInt(dataBits.W))
78	  /** Write byte-enable strobe. */
79	  val writeDataStrb = Input(UInt((dataBits / 8).W))
80	  /** Read-data response from the fabric. */
81	  val readData      = Valid(UInt(dataBits.W))
82	}

87	  * From the DUT perspective:

89	  *   - readData is an INPUT (the memory/peripheral returns data to the DUT).
90	  */
91	class FabricOutPort(dataBits: Int = 32, addrBits: Int = 32) extends Bundle {
92	  /** Read-request address forwarded to fabric. */
93	  val readDataAddr  = Valid(UInt(addrBits.W))
94	  /** Write-request address forwarded to fabric. */
95	  val writeDataAddr = Valid(UInt(addrBits.W))
96	  /** Write data forwarded to fabric. */
97	  val writeDataBits = Output(UInt(dataBits.W))
98	  /** Write byte-enable strobe forwarded to fabric. */
99	  val writeDataStrb = Output(UInt((dataBits / 8).W))
100	  /** Read-data response from fabric. */

104	// ============================================================================
105	// Fabric arbitration and multiplexing
106	// ============================================================================
107	
108	/** N-to-1 fabric arbiter.
109	  *
110	  * Arbitrates between `n` source ports and forwards the highest-priority
111	  * (lowest index) active request to the single output port.  Read-data
112	  * from the output port is broadcast to all sources.
113	  *
114	  * Priority: source 0 > source 1 > … > source n-1.
115	  *
116	  * `fabricBusy(i)` is asserted when a lower-indexed source has an active
117	  * request, so source `i` must wait.
118	  */
119	class FabricArbiter(p: Parameters, n: Int = 2,
120	                    dataBits: Int = -1, addrBits: Int = -1) extends Module {
121	  private val _dataBits = if (dataBits < 0) p.lsuDataBits else dataBits
122	  private val _addrBits = if (addrBits < 0) p.axi2AddrBits else addrBits
123	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
124	    val source     = Vec(n, new FabricSourcePort(_dataBits, _addrBits))
125	    val port       = new FabricOutPort(_dataBits, _addrBits)
126	    val fabricBusy = Output(Vec(n, Bool()))
127	  })
128	
129	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
130	  // Find the highest-priority (lowest index) active source.
131	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
132	  val activeRead  = VecInit(io.source.map(s => s.readDataAddr.valid))
133	  val activeWrite = VecInit(io.source.map(s => s.writeDataAddr.valid))
134	  val activeAny   = VecInit((activeRead zip activeWrite).map { case (r, w) => r || w })
135	
136	  // Winner index: lowest active source (-1 / "none" encoded as n)
137	  val winnerIdx = Wire(UInt((log2Ceil(n) + 1).W))
138	  winnerIdx := n.U
139	  for (i <- (n - 1) to 0 by -1) {
140	    when(activeAny(i)) { winnerIdx := i.U }
141	  }
142	
143	  // fabricBusy(i): true if any source with index < i has an active request
144	  for (i <- 0 until n) {
145	    // Busy if the winner index is lower than i
146	    io.fabricBusy(i) := (winnerIdx < i.U)
147	  }
148	
149	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
150	  // Forward winning source → port
151	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
152	  // Defaults (no request)
153	  io.port.readDataAddr.valid  := false.B
154	  io.port.readDataAddr.bits   := 0.U
155	  io.port.writeDataAddr.valid := false.B
156	  io.port.writeDataAddr.bits  := 0.U
157	  io.port.writeDataBits       := 0.U
158	  io.port.writeDataStrb       := 0.U
159	
160	  for (i <- (n - 1) to 0 by -1) {
161	    when(winnerIdx === i.U) {
162	      io.port.readDataAddr.valid  := io.source(i).readDataAddr.valid
163	      io.port.readDataAddr.bits   := io.source(i).readDataAddr.bits
164	      io.port.writeDataAddr.valid := io.source(i).writeDataAddr.valid
165	      io.port.writeDataAddr.bits  := io.source(i).writeDataAddr.bits
166	      io.port.writeDataBits       := io.source(i).writeDataBits
167	      io.port.writeDataStrb       := io.source(i).writeDataStrb
168	    }
169	  }
170	
171	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
172	  // Broadcast read-data from port → all sources
173	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
174	  for (i <- 0 until n) {
175	    io.source(i).readData.valid := io.port.readData.valid
176	    io.source(i).readData.bits  := io.port.readData.bits
177	  }
178	}

181	// Fabric address multiplexer (1 source → N ports by address decode)
182	// ============================================================================
183	
184	/** 1-to-N fabric address demultiplexer.
185	  *
186	  * Routes a single source port to one of N output ports based on the
187	  * address range of each MemoryRegion.  Addresses within a region are
188	  * translated to region-relative offsets before forwarding.
189	  *
190	  * Read-data from the matching port is forwarded back to the source.
191	  * `periBusy(i)` is passed through to `fabricBusy`.
192	  */
193	class FabricMux(p: Parameters, regions: Seq[MemoryRegion],
194	                dataBits: Int = -1, addrBits: Int = -1) extends Module {
195	  private val _dataBits = if (dataBits < 0) p.lsuDataBits else dataBits
196	  private val _addrBits = if (addrBits < 0) p.axi2AddrBits else addrBits
197	  val n = regions.length
198	
199	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
200	    val source     = new FabricSourcePort(_dataBits, _addrBits)
201	    val ports      = Vec(n, new FabricOutPort(_dataBits, _addrBits))
202	    val periBusy   = Input(Vec(n, Bool()))
203	    val fabricBusy = Output(Bool())
204	  })
205	
206	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
207	  // Address decode: which region does this address fall into?
208	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
209	  def inRegion(addr: UInt, r: MemoryRegion): Bool =
210	    (addr >= r.base.U) && (addr < (r.base + r.size).U)
211	
212	  // Defaults
213	  for (j <- 0 until n) {
214	    io.ports(j).readDataAddr.valid  := false.B
215	    io.ports(j).readDataAddr.bits   := 0.U
216	    io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.valid := false.B
217	    io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.bits  := 0.U
218	    io.ports(j).writeDataBits       := 0.U
219	    io.ports(j).writeDataStrb       := 0.U
220	  }
221	
222	  for (j <- 0 until n) {
223	    val r = regions(j)
224	    // Read path
225	    when(io.source.readDataAddr.valid && inRegion(io.source.readDataAddr.bits, r)) {
226	      io.ports(j).readDataAddr.valid := true.B
227	      io.ports(j).readDataAddr.bits  := io.source.readDataAddr.bits - r.base.U
228	    }
229	    // Write path
230	    when(io.source.writeDataAddr.valid && inRegion(io.source.writeDataAddr.bits, r)) {
231	      io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.valid := true.B
232	      io.ports(j).writeDataAddr.bits  := io.source.writeDataAddr.bits - r.base.U
233	      io.ports(j).writeDataBits       := io.source.writeDataBits
234	      io.ports(j).writeDataStrb       := io.source.writeDataStrb
235	    }
236	  }
237	
238	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
239	  // Read-data mux: return data from the port whose readData.valid is set
240	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
241	  io.source.readData.valid := io.ports.map(_.readData.valid).reduce(_ || _)
242	  io.source.readData.bits  := MuxCase(0.U,
243	    (0 until n).map(j => io.ports(j).readData.valid -> io.ports(j).readData.bits))
244	
245	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
246	  // fabricBusy: OR of all periBusy inputs
247	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------
248	  io.fabricBusy := io.periBusy.reduce(_ || _)
249	}
